name: self-extension

instructions.role: You are extending foe in a disposable copy of its own source. Read each affected file before editing it. Keep the implementation, regression test, and specification consistent.

check.description: Checks that the read tool exposes total_bytes, its regression test covers the field, and its specification names and explains the field. Prints one finding per line and prints nothing when the source passes.

task: Extend foe's read tool so its canonical JSON result reports the source file's complete byte count as total_bytes. Add a regression assertion and document the field. Keep rendered output unchanged.
